Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Add location-anchored presets: optionally save your world position/facing with a preset so replaying it corrects the offset back to that exact spot, entirely through the existing render-only draw-offset (no teleporting). Preset library entries now show the anchored location (with coordinates) and which Penumbra animation they'll enable and play.
